# Darn Tough EU

> Premium merino wool socks for every activity, backed by a lifetime guarantee and USA-made quality.

Darn Tough EU is the European storefront for Darn Tough Vermont, specializing in high-performance merino wool socks designed for hiking, running, winter sports, work, and everyday wear. All products feature moisture-wicking, blister prevention, and durability backed by an unconditional lifetime guarantee.

## Key Topics

- Merino Wool
- Lifetime Guarantee
- Hiking Socks

- Blister Prevention
- Work Socks

- Sock Packs
- Gift Ideas
- Darn Tough Vermont
- Lightweight
- Odor Resistance

## Shop by Activity

- [Hiking Socks](https://darntough.eu/collections/hiking-socks): Hiking sock collection with blister prevention and moisture-wicking merino wool
- [Running Socks](https://darntough.eu/collections/running-socks): Running sock collection featuring thin merino wool for blister prevention
- [Ski & Snowboard Socks](https://darntough.eu/collections/ski-snowboard-socks): Winter sports socks with merino wool for moisture-wicking and heat regulation
- [Work Socks](https://darntough.eu/collections/work-socks): Heavy-duty USA-made work socks with merino wool for durability and odor resistance
- [Lifestyle Socks - Dress & Casual](https://darntough.eu/collections/lifestyle-dress-casual-socks): Everyday merino wool socks for office, home, and casual wear
